verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Its built-in Aleph Agent works through Slack and its own UI, and nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server that external agents can connect to. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and mention no MCP endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
